notes.content:

Fingers crossed!

notes.title: Update - 0.1
notes.content:
- Added a launch option to enable windowed mode. 

In order to trigger this function:

[olist]
Left click on the R00000 game icon in your game library list
Select "Properties..." option
In the new pop-up window select "General"
In the "Launch options" text box enter "--enable-windowed"
Launch the game. It should start in windowed mode. You will also have a new option in the game menu to switch between windowed and fullscreen modes
[/olist]
Learn more about launch options in this game guide

notes.title: R00000 - OUT NOW
notes.content:
The day has come! R00000 is live for all of you to play, experience and uncover its secrets.


 During the week following the launch R00000 will be available for a discounted price of $2.70

From the humble beginnings during the 2023 Global Game Jam all the way to our first Steam release, R00000 shaped our team as much as we have tried to shape R00000. Make no mistake, this game is a small experience, however we hope that you will uncover the big beating heart we have built underneath its surface.


Don't hesitate and enter the basement!

- Weekend Warriors

notes.title: R00000 DEMO @ Lituanicon
notes.content:
Days before the upcoming release we will be showcasing R00000 live at a speculative fiction convention Lituanicon on 


October 7th, 10:00-18:00 in Vilnius, Lithuania

Lituanicon is the oldest gathering in Lithuania of people interested in literature, movies, TV series, games and all other fantasy and sci-fi related media. The event is free of charge. More about it can be found at lituanicon.lt

During the event:


 10:00-18:00 - R00000 will be playable trough an old CRT television set.
 17:00 - Team members will participate in a discussion about horror games (only in Lithuanian).

Visit Lituanicon and experience R00000 at Kalvarijų St. 137E, Vilnius, Lithuania 


See you at Lituanicon!

- Weekend Warriors

notes.title: R00000 is coming on 13th of October
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that R00000 is finished and will be released on the upcoming Friday the 13th!

The game will become available on 13th of October 2023. 

The exact times of release in different regions are:


 8 PM (20:00) EEST - Eastern Europe
 6 PM (18:00) GMT - Western Europe
 1 PM (13:00) EDT - US east coast
 10 AM (10:00) PDT - US west coast


We cannot wait!

- Weekend Warriors

notes.title: R00000 DEMO @ BLON Festival
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that R00000 was selected for the AWARE Games Award competition at BLON Animation & Video Games Festival! 

The event will host the latest award-winning feature films, short animated movies, several competitive film programs, an international exhibition of VR works and a video game exhibition/competition (of which R00000 is a part of). More about the festival can be found at blon.lt.

In order to celebrate this wonderful occasion we will be showcasing a demo version of R00000 during the four day festival. Don't miss the chance to try the game as it will be uniquely presented trough an old CRT television set.

Visit BLON and try R00000 for yourself at "Hofas" - Danės g. 8, Klaipėda, Lithuania during these times:


September 7th - 11:00-17:00
September 8th - 11:00-19:00
September 9th - 11:00-19:00
September 10th - 11:00-17:00


See you at BLON!

- Weekend Warriors
